title: Satwik-Chirag Exit World Championships After Quarter-Final Loss to Chinese Pair
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, were eliminated from the World Championships, ending their medal hopes.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty lost to China's Chang and Liang in the BWF World Championships quarter-finals, bowing out 21-18, 21-9, amid fitness concerns.

title: Treesa-Gayatri Secure India's First Women's Doubles World Championships Medal
indian_angle: This marks a historic achievement for Indian women's doubles, ensuring a medal at the World Championships after 15 years.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand defeated China's Jia and Zhang in a thrilling quarter-final, guaranteeing India its first women's doubles medal at the World Championships.

title: Coach Sumeeth Reddy Reveals Secrets Behind Treesa-Gayatri's World Championships Run
indian_angle: Indian fans gain insight into the mindset and preparation that led Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand to their historic World Championships medal.
summary: Coach Sumeeth Reddy shares exclusive details about Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's composure and determination, which propelled them to an unexpected medal at the World Championships despite being unseeded.

title: BAI's Successful Hosting of World Championships After 17 Years
indian_angle: The successful organization of the BWF World Championships in India after a long gap highlights India's growing capability as a major badminton host.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully hosted the BWF World Championships, improving facilities based on India Open feedback and showcasing India's organizational prowess after 17 years.

title: Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Exit at World Championships
indian_angle: A key Indian singles player, Lakshya Sen, faced an unexpected early exit from the BWF World Championships.
summary: India's Lakshya Sen was eliminated from the BWF World Championships after a challenging match against American teenager Garret Tan, marking a shock exit for the Indian hopeful.

title: PV Sindhu Exits World Championships After Epic 88-Minute Battle
indian_angle: India's premier women's singles player, PV Sindhu, fought valiantly before her exit from the World Championships, ending India's singles medal hopes.
